images.screen: A · 말풍선 — dragging the speech bubble across the final panel
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A single-screen art game about one comic panel. Composition: left two-thirds is a printed comic page on cream riso paper — three small panels on top (a departing night bus with speed lines, a hand holding an unopened letter, a rainy sky with a crescent moon) and one huge final panel below: a young woman in three-quarter profile, wet black hair, half-lidded eye, a raindrop or tear on her cheek, deliberately ambiguous mouth. A white oval speech bubble reading "괜찮아." is being dragged by the player, lifted with a drop shadow, a pink dotted gaze line linking it to her eye, and faint blue dashed target slots in other spots. Right third: a stacked UI of flat cards with thick ink borders and hard offset shadows showing the current reading "체념" in huge bold type and three bar meters (안도 / 체념 / 거짓말), plus pill-shaped dialogue cards. Risograph print style: black ink linework, pink and blue halftone dots with slight misregistration, rain hatching, paper grain, soft vignette. Warm cream, ink navy, riso pink, cobalt blue, one yellow caption box. Text constraints: the dialogue cards read exactly "괜찮아.", "정말 괜찮아?", "…아니야.", "사실, 아직도 아파.", "언젠가, 다시."; the three meters read exactly 안도 11, 체념 62, 거짓말 27 (summing to 100).

images.screen: B · 세 번의 읽기 — the same face read three ways
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Result screen of a comic-panel art game. Three identical close-up panels of the same young woman with wet black hair and an ambiguous expression stand side by side, slightly rotated like printed cards with hard ink shadows. Only the speech bubble differs: top-left "괜찮아.", a dashed whisper bubble "가." near her head, and a lower bubble "고마웠어." pointing up. Each panel carries a bold label block in the corner — "체념" on cream, "거짓말" on hot pink, "안도" on cobalt blue — and a tilted pink rubber-stamp percentage. Below, a filmstrip of twelve small comic thumbnails, some locked with hatched question marks, the last one highlighted in pink. A single line of text at the bottom concludes the chapter. Risograph print aesthetic: cream paper grain, halftone pink and blue dots, black ink lines, rain hatching, gentle vignette, flat even lighting like a scanned printed page. Quiet, melancholic, precise graphic design.
